subject: Switching Intro Demo to Hybrid Technical Deep Dive — logistics and prework
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@novacorp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alexa Bell <alexa.bell@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Intro to Redwood — would like to convert to technical deep dive

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the introductory session outline last week. We had been planning the light demo on May 4, but two things changed on our side: my lead engineer will be traveling the week of May 4 for a board visit, and the product team wants to see a deeper technical session before we move to a POC.

Would your team be open to converting the planned intro demo into a technical deep dive (90-120 minutes) that includes our engineering leads and a discussion of integration patterns, latency expectations, and security controls? If possible wed like to cover pre-deployment checklist items so Legal/IT can pre-clear any questions.

Preferred windows on our side:
- Tue May 11, 10:00-12:00 PT
- Wed May 12, 13:00-15:00 PT

If those dont work, we can also do a hybrid plan: a 90-minute remote deep dive now and follow with an on-site half-day POC workshop when travel is feasible.

Can you confirm which engineers from Redwood should join, and whether you have a short prework checklist we can share with our SRE team?

Thanks,
Samir Kapoor
Head of Platform Integrations
Novacorp
[Attachment: novacorp-eng-reqs.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro to Redwood — would like to convert to technical deep dive

Hi Samir,

Appreciate the heads up and the clear ask. Converting to a technical deep dive makes sense and we can absolutely support a hybrid approach if travel is tight for your team. Proposed plan from our side:

Option A — Remote technical deep dive (recommended now)- 90 minutes remote deep dive covering: architecture overview, integration patterns, KV cache/latency expectations, quantization tradeoffs, and a short 15-minute Q&A.- Attendees from Redwood: Marissa (SE lead), Karthik (solutions architect), Ava (runtime PM).

Option B — Hybrid split- 90-minute remote deep dive now to align on scope and prework- Optional half-day on-site POC workshop (hands-on) within 4 weeks once your engineers' travel clears. Redwood will bring an engineer for pairing and an infra lead.

Prework we can share immediately: a short repo with sample payloads and an environment checklist (link below). We will also attach a draft agenda and a short demo deck.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue May 11, 10:00-11:30
- Wed May 12, 13:30-15:00

If neither fits, share 2-3 alternate windows and we will align.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-demo-deck-v1.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: hybrid-agenda.ics (text/calendar)]

Prework link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/novacorp-prework

If this plan looks good I will have Marissa pick a final time and send a calendar invite with the remote dial-in + agenda.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@novacorp.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro to Redwood — would like to convert to technical deep dive

Hi Samir — copying the engineering folks who will join the session.

Concrete availability from our side matching Rafael's proposal:
- Tue May 11, 10:00-11:30 PT 
- Wed May 12, 13:30-15:00 PT

Link to quick availability poll (one-click): https://calendar.google.com/event?id=abc123

Prework checklist (short):
- Sample payloads and sequence length distribution (upload to the repo above)
- Network egress rules and whether you need VPC peering or proxy details
- Any redaction/PII masking policies required at inference time

Could you share the names and calendar addresses for the Novacorp engineers who will attend so I can share the repo access and prework items in advance? I also attached a calendar stub for May 11 that we can confirm.

Attachments: [Attachment: prework-checklist.md (text/markdown)], [Attachment: may11-stub.ics (text/calendar)]

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alexa Bell <alexa.bell@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro to Redwood — would like to convert to technical deep dive

Marissa, Rafael,

Thanks — May 11 10:00-11:30 PT works for us. Confirming attendees from Novacorp:
- Samir Kapoor (samir.kapoor@novacorp.com)
- Rahul Desai (rahul.desai@novacorp.com) - Lead SRE
- Priya Menon (priya.menon@novacorp.com) - Product Engineer

Travel update: Rahul's travel was rescheduled to later in May so the team will join remotely for the deep dive. We like the hybrid path and will confirm on-site availability for the POC after the remote session.

One request for the agenda: please include a short 10-minute architecture/routing rundown up front so Rahul can map the proposed setup to our infra. Also please add any required port ranges or IP allowlist items to the prework checklist.

I'll accept the May 11 calendar invite once it's sent and will upload the payload samples to the repo by EOD Friday.

Appreciate the flexibility — Samir
